annotation.evidence_span: causes any flow-control window to exceed the maximum size
annotation.interpretation_a: The condition applies to *each* flow-control window (stream and connection). If *any* window exceeds the maximum, it's an error.
annotation.interpretation_b: The condition applies to the *sum* of all flow-control windows. If the combined size exceeds the maximum, it's an error.
annotation.justification: The phrase "any flow-control window" is ambiguous. It could refer to each individual stream and connection flow-control window, or to the total combined size of all windows. These interpretations lead to different implementations.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 'any' refers to each individual window or the aggregate of all windows. A clarification on whether the check is per-stream, per-connection, or aggregate would resolve the ambiguity.
